title: outcome/1: the few bytes a Run's final step writes: how the Run ended and whose fault it was, in the run record's codes; null for a Run that succeeded.

engine_started.description: Whether the run job's Engine step started, by the outcome the job hands on for it: false where GitHub skipped it because a step before it failed, and the Run spent no model; true where it ran. Absent where the job said neither, and read then as a Run that may have reached the model (issue 757)
